name: Rosette
description: Two screens at different angles, each in its own ink, the way process colours overlap.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -20%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%) 0 0 / 18% 18%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%) 0 0 / 18% 18%; -webkit-transform: rotate(15deg); transform: rotate(15deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -20%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%) 0 0 / 18% 18%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%) 0 0 / 18% 18%; -webkit-transform: rotate(-30deg); transform: rotate(-30deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
